title: SRE, Platform & DevOps opportunities
lede: Six-keyword rotation against We Work Remotely, region eligibility confirmed from each posting's own detail page (the site's generic 'Anywhere in the World' tag is not trustworthy on its own).
latest_update: Latest update: October 9, 2026 — all 6 queries ran; two new postings qualify (BlueGeko IT Infrastructure Engineer, EPAM Lead Cloud Engineer) and were auto-filed. The Proxify Azure roles remain CET-only.

notes_sections.heading: October 5 full-read pass
items: Beyond the six default queries I searched Infrastructure Engineer, SRE and DevOps and fetched every result’s detail page, then scored the description text (28 postings; the first run opened only 3 of them). Real region lines were read, not WWR’s generic tag. Highest DevOps content: a principal infrastructure role (US only), JFrog Senior Professional Services DevOps (already Applied), Proxify Senior DevOps (Azure, CET ±3h) and Proxify Senior Platform/Cloud Engineer, Datadog advocates and Vercel security (US), Fastly Senior SRE – Networks (US), and the EPAM Lead Cloud Engineer described below.

EPAM Lead Cloud Engineer (posted 5 days ago, apply by Oct 30): an Azure/AKS internal-developer-platform role — Terraform/OpenTofu modules, AKS operations, Backstage golden paths, image-factory pipelines, 5+ yrs Azure IaC and 1+ yr leadership — squarely in Marc’s lane and EPAM is where he has two Applied rows. But WWR’s region line is only the generic tag, the text asks for B2+ English, and EPAM’s own site lists the matching Lead Cloud DevOps Engineer (AKS) as Poland-remote. Not filed; worth a direct check on careers.epam.com for a Canada requisition.

method: October 9 run: six WWR queries in a real browser, candidates opened and region lines read individually. Bare-title rotation per the check-wwr skill's six mandatory queries (DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Cloud Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer), each searched independently via weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/search?term=. Eligibility gated on each posting's own detail-page location line, never the decorative "Anywhere in the World" tag. This run found no new inventory since 2026-09-21 — the same 7 in-family postings resurfaced under the same URLs, already reflected in applications.md and this report. Repository notes (job_sources.md) continue to show single-broad-term searches ("DevOps", "Cloud", "Platform") surfacing more volume historically than this skill's mandated bare-title rotation; the bare-title rotation was used here per the skill's written mandatory-query list.
